req.title: Accept comma-separated status codes
req.statement: The system shall select one code at random when /status/<code> is called with a comma-separated list.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /status/<codes> with a comma-separated list shall select one code at random. Tests must verify: (1) positive — a valid comma-separated list returns one of the listed codes; (2) negative — an invalid code in the list returns 400; (3) boundary — a single-element 'list' (no comma) behaves as a direct code lookup; plus additional cases for weighted selection syntax, exact status code membership, and mutation-resilient assertions on the 400 error path.

tests.name: test_comma_separated_returns_one_of_listed_codes
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: Every response status code is a member of {200, 301, 404}
No status code outside that set is ever returned
At least one distinct code appears across 20 trials (probabilistic sanity)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-016: comma-separated list -> random selection from listed codes
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
allowed = {200, 301, 404}
observed = set()
for _ in range(20):
    r = client.get('/status/200,301,404')
    assert r.status_code in allowed, f'Unexpected status {r.status_code}'
    observed.add(r.status_code)
assert len(observed) >= 1

The comma-detection branch is exercised (not the single-code branch)

    assert r.status_code != 301
